detail_text: Specifically, A.Complaint CM [redacted] 002/25 was received via email on January 16, 2025, from a customer regarding an out-of-specification (OOS) result for an unspecified impurity in the Related Substances by HPLC test during analysis of [redacted] intermediate, batch number [redacted] Your firm's investigation, documented in C [redacted] /002/25 dated January 16, 2025, determined that your firm did not use the specified column required by the customer, despite the Method of Analysis (MOA) requiring use of that column or equivalent.
